title: DestructionEvidence
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.DestructionEvidence). Immutable proof that a destruction actually happened, created exactly once per governed record and never updated or deleted - it outlives the record whose destruction it evidences. evidence_digest is an opaque, caller-computed digest of whatever the executing system considers its proof (a tombstone id, a storage receipt); no document bytes and no personal payload are stored here (PACK-09 required invariant 13). Real evidence CONTENT and cryptographic version chains are deferred to PACK-11. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
